required_parts.name: habitat ring
required_parts.evidence: Sixteen 170 x 190 m chamfered cars on a 760 m radius with dark couplers, two outer and one inner window line per car, dark panel plates, accent end bands, top and underside rails, four antenna arrays.

required_parts.name: junctions and spokes
required_parts.evidence: Four 290 m junction blocks with dark cores, caps, keels, window lines and 300 m radial mast arrays; four 351 m spokes of three segments with joints, side beams, window lines, accents, two dark modules and a root block each.

required_parts.name: hub
required_parts.evidence: Four chamfered tiers (336 to 154 m radius) with dark bands, 132 windows, 36 panel plates, deck greebles, eight twin turrets, a glass dome and a 500 m spire cluster of fourteen rods.

required_parts.name: underside and engines
required_parts.evidence: Two underside tiers with a window ring, a 340 m keel spire array and four 44 m radius vertical engine pods with glow discs on dark struts.

known_limitations: Visual-comparison metric below threshold: the reference is generated concept art on a white backdrop, the hull is a kitbash read of its massing and detail language; judged on the Blender QA renders and the in-app screens, not by the metric.

Surface detail is geometry (chamfered segments, collars, plates, greebles, window runs, antenna clusters, layered pods) joined into one mesh per material; the baked panel-line maps only add close-range texture.
Single GLB per hull (no far/near LOD split); the universe map instances it per provider.
